skills.name: Fantasy
skills.text: When Xiao Qiao receives damage, she may discard a heart card and pass the damage to any other character. That character then draws X cards, where X is the number of health points they are missing after the damage is passed.

skills.name: Beauty
skills.text: All of Xiao Qiao's spades are treated as hearts.

source.site: English Sanguosha (Jason Keeney and Scott Maresh)
